packageRules.description: Cargo dependencies are linked into the released binary, so a bump only reaches users through a release — build is in release_commits. Needed because :semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers types lockfile-only updates as chore, and a patch-level security fix arrives lockfile-only: ammonia 4.1.4 (an XSS fix) landed on colporteur master as chore(deps) and cut nothing. Tooling, dev-dependencies and actions never reach the artifact and stay chore.

The docs site under `docs/`. `chore`, not the `fix(deps)` config:recommended would give it: release_commits is ^(feat|fix|perf|refactor|build), so a Starlight or theme bump would publish a crates.io version with no code change. Docs dependencies never reach the binary.
